entities.name: Léon Lemartin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Théodore Clovis Edmond Lemartin, known as Léon Lemartin, was a French pioneer aviator and test pilot who set a world record on 3 February 1911 at Pau, France when he carried seven passengers in a Blériot XIII Aerobus. He then took eight, eleven and thirteen passengers aloft the following month. He is also known as the world's first professional test pilot.
